Validation receipt is stale, so no test evidence supports approval.

Excerpts are truncated and no tests are certified (saved test evidence is for a different source snapshot), so these are review proposals, not confirmed defects. (1) nfl_props.py scenarios() lines 126-153: probabilities come from shifting prior-season position-level residuals onto today's mean (a homoscedastic additive error). This ignores heteroscedasticity (variance scales with the mean and line) and ties/clipping nuance; samples are not per-market calibrated. The code correctly labels it uncalibrated, and acceptance is held by ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED=False (line 30), which is appropriate. Candidate rows also drop pushes only via above/(above+below), so the bettor-facing p ignores push refund value in edge (line 300: edge=belief-1/decimal), a minor EV overstatement on whole-number lines. (2) nfl_props.py settle() lines 239-271: the stats cache silently skips when the season file is absent (continue at line 252), fine, but a missing snaps/roster file sets frames[key]=None without recording a source hash; cash is credited inside the same call as the ticket UPDATE, guarded by rowcount, which is safe against double settlement. Settlement basis 'snap_confirmed_zero' infers zero stats from snap presence; verify stats files always contain every player with offensive snaps, else a legitimately missing row is graded as 0 (definite risk, depends on data not shown). (3) props_book.py belief() line 173-180 and tick lines 382-383: belief is computed with seeded random bias and then overwritten by context.prop(...) probability, so edge is recomputed; verify the evidence layer does not stack bias a second time (possible double adjustment, hypothesis since evidence_decisions is not supplied). Also result_for uses points reconciliation only for NBA; NFL has no equivalent finality check beyond non-null scores.

Top observations (hypotheses/missing validation unless noted): (1) prop_research.py:147-150 refreshes the reference quote only from fresh_quotes and does not reject quotes observed at or after tip; with tip<=now rows moving straight to settlement, in-play or post-tip observations could be stored as the reference. It is labelled verified_closing_line=False, but verify props.fresh_quotes enforces pre-tip. (2) prop_research.py:126-131: the specialist forecast selects the contract by maximum edge across sides/books (max over options at line 129), then owner and consensus are scored on that same selected contract. The selection is conditioned on the minutes_usage model's own edge, so its Brier/log-loss/unit_return is optimistically biased relative to the benchmarks scored on its picks (selection effect, not leakage). Also line 136 marks owner_p/market_p as SHADOW_CANDIDATE at gap>=.02 with no calibration check, and the market consensus never uses the quote's own book prices, so gaps vs. the same price can be inconsistent. (3) bankroll_policy.py:48-62 uses base=min(initial,equity) but open_limit/risk accounting treats opposing tickets at full stake (intended, conservative). The per-sport reserve at line 52-54 applies only to the sportsbook regime for NBA/NFL game lines; the 'beyond_24h' room applies only when the new game is distant (line 50), while missing tip_utc on existing tickets counts as distant, which can silently starve long-dated allowance. Also prop_research.py:120 compares latest-appearance team_id to the snapshot team, and prop_research.py:118 assigns agents by player-id hash modulo a changing agent list, so identity can drift across runs (hypothesis). Tests are synthetic and do not certify model quality.
